Senses.Explanation: The line completes a spring scene in which a graceful figure entering the flower garden draws an oriole from the willow. A later interview uses the same line as the student’s response to the interviewer’s images of washing pearls and combing willows. The Continued Ancient Essentials and Jiatai Lamp transmit the same verse; Jingci Huihui preserves an independent dialogue reuse.

Senses.Explanation: The shrimp unable to jump from the dipper gives a compact image of confinement despite frantic motion. Yunmen’s proxy answer and Shuangquan’s replies establish the saying, while senior monk Ying uses it in an exchange with Faju Yiyu; the image does not assert a zoological claim.
